fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock fell 18% over the past month, but Q3 earnings remain solid, with 56 analysts' 12-month median target price of $650 suggesting 28% upside.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion represents 45% year-over-year growth, with data center business leading the way and data center revenue surging 97% to $8.5 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: Q4 revenue guidance of $17 billion implies 66% year-over-year growth, with 2026 annual revenue forecast of $52.7 billion or more, representing 52% year-over-year growth.
